summary: This Form 8-K reports the closing of a CMBS securitization by Citigroup Commercial Mortgage Trust 2026-MFAM1, a Delaware issuing entity. The depositor, Citigroup Commercial Mortgage Securities Inc., issued commercial mortgage pass-through certificates under a pooling and servicing agreement dated July 1, 2026. Public certificates totaling $706.575 million were sold via underwriters, and private certificates of $110.275 million were sold in a Rule 4(a)(2) exempt transaction. This is a routine asset-backed securities issuance, not a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring.
